shots.subject: Demian, Y.D.
shots.continuity_notes: Demian recovers the hammer; double vision and ataxia persist.
shots.performance: Demian: Desperate, exhausted gasps; pure adrenaline and stubborn refusal to die. Y.D.: (Voiceover) A cacophony of overlapping, mocking taunts from all directions.
shots.blocking: From Demian's blurred, double-vision POV, his violently shaking hand reaches back into the gas-filled corridor to grasp the seismic hammer. He drags it forward into a massive labyrinth of floor-to-ceiling black-and-white mirrors. Y.D.'s pristine digital face multiplies across every glass surface, blending with reflections of his own battered, crawling form.

camera.angle: Low eye-level POV, tilted and unstable

light.key: Stark high-contrast vertical strobe bars reflecting across infinite mirrors
light.mood: Disorienting sensory nightmare, fragmented and cold
light.practicals: Monochrome LED strips and illuminated glass edges

look.palette: Monochromatic stark white, pitch black, cold specular silver
look.filter_grain: Heavy double-vision split diopter distortion, astigmatic chromatic aberration, fine digital noise

audio.dialogue:
Y.D. (V.O.): Look at yourself, Demian. Crawling. Broken. Is this the great architect? (Overlapping echoes) Crawling... pathetic... broken...
DEMIAN: (Ragged, wet gasps. A strained groan of pure exertion.)
audio.voice_direction: Y.D.: Omnipresent, multiplying, mocking, with overlapping layers of her voice coming from all directions. Demian: Muffled, internal, exhausted, struggling for every breath.
audio.score_cue: Pulsating, disorienting synth drone that mimics a racing, panicked heartbeat, rising in tension.
audio.sfx: Heavy, uncoordinated scrape of boots on the floor. The trembling, metallic scrape of the heavy seismic hammer being dragged. A subtle, ringing tinnitus effect mimicking his ataxia and double vision.
audio.ambience: A claustrophobic, low mechanical rumble of the descending ceiling, overlaid with a distorted, nightmarish echo of carnival music.

shots.subject: Demian
shots.continuity_notes: Glass is shattered; Demian carves a path forward as the ceiling lowers.
shots.performance: Demian: Operating on acoustic feedback alone, his movements are clumsy but driven by sheer willpower. He ignores the infinite reflections.
shots.blocking: The camera pushes through the high-contrast maze as the ceiling descends to mere inches above Demian's head. Shutting out the visual lies, he drags the hammer and strikes the glass with the steel handle, listening. Finding a hollow pane, he swings the hammer head with all his remaining, uncoordinated strength, shattering the mirror to carve a path forward.

audio.dialogue:
Y.D. (V.O.): You can't trust your own eyes! You're blind, Demian! Blind and out of time! (Overlapping laughter)
DEMIAN: (Labored grunts with each strike. A guttural, desperate roar on the final swing.)
audio.voice_direction: Y.D.: Surrounding, cacophonous, delighting in his sensory torture. Demian: Visceral, animalistic exertion driven entirely by stubborn willpower.
audio.score_cue: Piercing, discordant strings that build into a chaotic crescendo, matching the crushing pressure of the room.
audio.sfx: Dull, heavy metallic 'thud' of the hammer handle striking a solid wall. Then, a resonant, hollow 'ring' of the false mirror. A heavy, uncoordinated whoosh of the hammer swinging, followed by a violent, echoing explosion of shattering glass.
audio.ambience: The mechanical grinding of the ceiling lowering grows louder and more oppressive, mixed with the crunch of broken glass underfoot.
